title: Gideon and the Horizon
author: Jonah Brightwater
blurb: Paloma Yarrow, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
